$description: YouTube case study 提取 schema。与 IG 版本平行,但字段调整以适配 YT 特性(video/short/live 类型、CTR/AVD 数据、YT SEO 相关)。

cases.thumbnail_description: founder face + 大字标语 'SEO in 2025'
cases.title: SEO in 2025: What Actually Works
cases.description_excerpt: In this video I'll walk through the 3 SEO tactics that actually move the needle in 2025...

engagement.notes: 博客引用的 CTR/AVD 数据为 creator 后台 disclosure,可信度中

cases.why_featured: 博客选它作为 'tutorial-focus + founder credibility' 组合的典型样本;CTR 8.4% 远高于平台平均 4-5%
cases.insight_from_blog: 缩略图选择 face + 承诺具体成果('actually works')在 SEO tutorial 类效果最强
cases.atoms_relevance: SaaS Template §5 caption pattern:'X in [year]: what actually works' 结构;founder face 缩略图对 credibility 类内容显著提升 CTR

$field_definitions.video_url: YT 视频 URL(canonical watch URL 优先)
$field_definitions.video_type: 枚举:long_form | short | live | community_post | premiere
$field_definitions.thumbnail_description: 文字描述缩略图内容(不复制图片,合规)
$field_definitions.title_length_chars: int;YT title 硬上限 100 字符
$field_definitions.description_excerpt: 博客引用的 description 片段;前 100-150 字符最重要(mobile 折叠前可见)
$field_definitions.engagement.avd_seconds: Average View Duration 绝对秒数;博客/creator 后台披露值
$field_definitions.engagement.avp_percent: Average View Percentage 相对完成率(0-100)
$field_definitions.engagement.ctr_percent: Click-Through Rate(缩略图点击率),YT 平台平均 4-5%
$field_definitions.engagement.as_reported_date: 博客/后台数据的时间点
$field_definitions.insight_from_blog: 博客对这个 case 的核心观察
$field_definitions.atoms_relevance: 我们的判断:适合哪类 Atoms 用户参考、可复用什么模式

removed: engagement.saves(YT 无 saves 概念,已用 likes 替代)
engagement.reach(YT 用 views + impressions,不用 reach)
$fields_vs_ig_schema_diff.rationale: YT 数据模型比 IG 丰富(有 CTR/AVD 明确数字),schema 需要承载这些额外字段以支撑 §9 winning structures 归纳
